styles.name: Grey denim waist apron with a centre mitred pocket, eyelets for the reversed self fabric ties and the Fuego by Fenwick logo in gold — Oliver Harvey, Fenwicks
styles.desc: DENIM WAIST APRON · Retail pocket with two stitch-line pen pockets, right side as worn · Reversed self fabric waist ties through large antique brass eyelets at the waist · Reverse hem turning · Antique brass rivets at the top corners of the pocket · No red OH tax tab, no OH woven label: Tibard plain printed wash label · Fuego by Fenwick logo in gold on the pocket, set before make-up
fabrics: Grey denim Art Murray 315 gsm 100% cotton, 1.50 m width (P and R) — rating 0.70 m, the same as All Costings; the sheet gives the location as B2, Sage holds the cloth at C4
trims: Grey Coats Epic 80's 9971 for all stitching. Sage holds no 9971 code: the nearest coded shades are storm grey 09963 (CMP-THR-EP80-09963-64) and light grey 09404 (CMP-THR-EP80-09404-206).

Tibard plain printed label: 100% cotton · 50° wash · do not bleach · 2 dot iron · P dry clean · do not tumble dry. Set in the right side seam as worn, just below the base of the re-inforcement patch. No red OH tax tab and no Oliver Harvey woven label. Printed at Tibard on the 25 mm nylon label tape.
30E/R AB 30 mm antique brass eyelets, 2 per apron. Set to the top of the side seams: centre of the eyelet 3 cm down from the top and 3 cm in from the side seam, finished.
The ring for each 30 mm eyelet: 2 per apron.
010B/7P - 011B antique brass invert nipple rivet and post, one at each top corner of the pocket: 2 per apron. No Sage code on the trims list.
mfg: Logo the pocket before make-up: see CUSTOMER BRANDING.
Make the waist ties. Reverse the cloth so the wrong side is uppermost. Bag out both ends and topstitch one side.
Set the re-inforcement patches at the top edge, right side uppermost.

Double turn the side seams and top and topstitch 12 mm, enclosing the re-inforcement patch for the eyelets. Set the label to the right side seam as worn just below the base of the re-inforcement patch.
Double turn the hem onto the right side so the reverse of the fabric shows, and topstitch 12 mm.
Set the pocket hem: turn under 1 cm, turn 2.7 cm and twin needle topstitch. The bottom row of stitching 2.5 cm from the top of the pocket.
Set the retail pocket to the apron, centrally within the width of the apron and 10 cm down from the finished top edge. Twin needle to the apron.
Set the pen pocket stitch lines, right side as worn: the first row 3 cm from the inside row of twin needle stitching, 13 cm deep; the second row 3 cm from the first, 13 cm deep.

After the eyelets are set (finishing) the apron comes back for the waist ties: set the tie through the eyelet 4 cm and stitch down to secure, join on the inside as worn. Box stitch 2 stitch wide to the width of the strap.
fin: Set the rivets to the top corners of the pocket.
Set the eyelets: centre of the eyelet 3 cm in from the side seam and 3 cm down from the top. The apron goes back to the machinist for the waist ties.
Check, trim, press, fold and bag. No tissue. Product sticker to the bottom right hand corner of the bag.
styles.brandPlace: Fuego by Fenwick logo, 6.5 cm, in gold thread 1855, set to the right side of the pocket as worn before make-up. Centre of the embroidery 14 cm from the right side of the pocket (cut edge) and centrally within the cut depth of the pocket.
styles.note: Works order FENAPP059914DEN for Fenwicks, Oliver Harvey (from sample SR342; JH created 30/7/15; set to Fenwicks YL 12/8/15; embroidery information JH 7/9/15 and 15/9/16; new Fuego by Fenwick logo in the same position JH 14/8/23). The Fenwicks version of the OH grey denim waist apron OHAPP0599GD: no red tax tab and no OH woven label, a Tibard plain wash label instead, and the logo on the pocket. The logo is the record's own branding, so it is not a stock style. Rating 0.70 m on CO5014DEN, the same as All Costings. The sheet is in works-orders/FENAPP059914DEN-Fenwicks.xlsx.
